Step 1: Use search and read_file to thoroughly scan the entire Gradum project at /Users/gwy/Documents/Code_Project/Gradum. Start by exploring the directory structure, then read every .py file in agent.py, client.py, launcher/, skills/, utils/, and prompts/. Understand every class, every method, every feature.

Step 3: Start a simple HTTP server (python3 -m http.server 8080) in the project root directory and then open http://localhost:8080/web_features.html in my default browser using run_cmd(command="open http://localhost:8080/web_features.html").

Do not ask me any questions.

2. After exploration, create a to_do list with all necessary tasks for building the web version. Then execute them step by step 
3. When the server is running, use run_cmd to open it in my default browser.
